text:
maria: heads-up — nightly SAST (trunk) flagged HIGH: insecure deserialization in payment-core (pkg/serialize). CI blocked the merge. scanner-bot posted findings below.
scanner-bot: [automated scan] HIGH: insecure deserialization pattern detected. File: payment-core/src/main/java/com/redwood/pay/Serializer.java:47-62. Potential gadget chain on ObjectInputStream usage.
scanner-bot: snippet:
```java
ObjectInputStream in = new ObjectInputStream(socket.getInputStream());
Object obj = in.readObject();
```
maria: I reproduced locally. The payload is decrypted first using the payment-envelope key (KMS) then deserialized. So access to that key is part of triage.
ajay: if we patch now, how long to unstick CI? quick fix or emergency exception?
maria: full fix needs a safe-serialization rewrite + tests. That will take >24h. Product wants to unblock today. Two options: emergency policy exception with audit evidence or canary deploy with runtime guard.
nora: per emergency runbook: we allow a one-time "policy-exception" for deploys if SecOps ticket, RBAC ephemeral grant for validator SA, and auditable evidence (KMS audit + deploy logs). Must record scope and TTL.
tim: who can grant ephemeral KMS decrypt rights? infra-admin or SRE lead? I can perform a 1hr grant if security signs off.
olga: +1 to ephemeral grant but require strict logging: audithook + PR link + postmortem within 72h. No permanent policy changes without remediation.
maria: I'll open SecOps ticket and attach repro + scan. @tim please prepare the ephemeral grant command we can run once ticket is approved. Example command we would run: 
```bash
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/payment/cryptoKeys/payment-envelope \\  --member=serviceAccount:deployer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --condition='title="emergency-1719998888",expression=timestamp("2026-03-22T15:00:00Z")<timestamp()' 
```
ajay: can we add a SAST rule to reject ObjectInputStream usages in pre-commit / CI so this won't happen again?
maria: yes — adding a custom rule to the SAST config + premerge lint. For the exception flow: 1) create SecOps ticket w/ repro & scan, 2) infra grants 1hr decrypt to deployer SA, 3) deploy canary to 5% with enhanced logging and runtime sanitizer, 4) complete full code fix and ship within 72h or rollback.
nora: adding checklist to runbook now. Required evidence: KMS audit entry id, deployer identity, PR diff, canary metrics, test artifacts.
maria: ticket created: SEC-2026-143 — attaching repro and scan output. I'll update here as we go. :thumbsup:
tim: I can coordinate the grant once SecOps signs off. Ping me with ticket id and desired window, I'll paste the audit event id after I run it.
maria: thanks team — updating ticket with requested artifacts and triggering canary when infra confirms grant.
